content: If the distance of the point (1, $$-$$2, 3) from the plane x + 2y $$-$$ 3z + 10 = 0 measured parallel to the line, $${{x - 1} \over 3} = {{2 - y} \over m} = {{z + 3} \over 1}$$ is $$\sqrt {{7 \over 2}} $$, then the value of |m| is equal to _________.
